column8: Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW → Prop := fun w => w.k < 8 ∧ w.cur < 2 ^ w.k
∀ (e : List Bool) {w : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW}, w.Inv → (w.pushAll e).bits = w.bits ++ e ∧ (w.pushAll e).Inv
∀ {w : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW}, w.Inv → ∀ (b : Bool), (w.push b).bits = w.bits ++ [b] ∧ (w.push b).Inv
Array Bool → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastCue → Prop := fun B t M => Array.size t = B.size ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), t[p]?.bind id = M[p]?

∀ {B : Array Bool} {t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable} {M : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastCue}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueRel B t M → ∀ {i : ℕ}, i < B.size → ∀ (n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueRel B (Array.setIfInBounds t i (Option.some n)) (Std.HashMap.insert M i n)
Array Bool → ℕ → List Bool → Prop := fun B i L => ∀ (j : ℕ) (h : j < L.length), B[i + j]? = Option.some L[j]
∀ {B : Array Bool} {i : ℕ} {L₁ L₂ : List Bool}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (L₁ ++ L₂) ↔ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i L₁ ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B (i + L₁.length) L₂
∀ {B : Array Bool} {i : ℕ} {b : Bool} {L : List Bool}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (b :: L) ↔ B[i]? = Option.some b ∧ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B (i + 1) L
∀ {B : Array Bool} {i : ℕ} {b : Bool} {L : List Bool}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (b :: L) → i < B.size
∀ {B : Array Bool} {i : ℕ} {L : List Bool}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i L → L ≠ [] → i + L.length ≤ B.size
∀ {B : Array Bool} {L R : List Bool}, B.toList = L ++ R → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B 0 L
{motive : Minidregg.Theory.Noun → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → ((n : ℕ) → motive (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.atom n)) → motive t
∀ (k n : ℕ), n ≤ k → n < 2 ^ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.bitLenAux k n ∧ (n ≠ 0 → 0 < Minidregg.Theory.Noun.bitLenAux k n ∧ 2 ^ (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.bitLenAux k n - 1) ≤ n)
∀ {bs : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical bs = Bool.true ↔ ∃ n, n.jam = bs
∀ {bs bs' : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical bs = Bool.true → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.canonical bs' = Bool.true → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue bs = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.cue bs' → bs = bs'

∀ (B : Array Bool) (c k i acc : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (List.replicate c Bool.false ++ [Bool.true]) → c < k → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.countZeros B k i acc = Option.some (acc + c)

∀ {B : Array Bool} {pos x fuel : ℕ} {t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B pos (Bool.false :: Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat x) → 1 ≤ fuel → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.decode B fuel pos t = Option.some (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.atom x, pos + (Bool.false :: Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat x).length, Array.setIfInBounds t pos (Option.some (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.atom x)))

∀ {B : Array Bool} {pos p fuel : ℕ} {t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable} {n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B pos (Bool.true :: Bool.true :: Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat p) → t[p]? = Option.some (Option.some n) → 1 ≤ fuel → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.decode B fuel pos t = Option.some (n, pos + (Bool.true :: Bool.true :: Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat p).length, t)

∀ (B : Array Bool) (n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (m : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.JamTable) (pos : ℕ) (t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable) (K fuel : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B pos (n.jamAux m pos).1 → (∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (p : ℕ), a.lookupPos m = Option.some p → p < pos) → (∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (p : ℕ), a.lookupPos m = Option.some p → a.size ≤ K → t[p]? = Option.some (Option.some a)) → n.size ≤ K → Array.size t = B.size → (n.jamAux m pos).1.length ≤ fuel → ∃ t', Minidregg.Theory.Noun.decode B fuel pos t = Option.some (n, pos + (n.jamAux m pos).1.length, t') ∧ Array.size t' = B.size ∧ (∀ q < pos, t'[q]? = t[q]?) ∧ ∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (p : ℕ), a.lookupPos (n.jamAux m pos).2 = Option.some p → a.size ≤ K → t'[p]? = Option.some (Option.some a)

∀ {a b : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, a = b ↔ a.mug = b.mug ∧ Decidable.decide (a = b) = Bool.true

∀ {M : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastTable} {m : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.JamTable}, (∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), M[a]? = a.lookupPos m) → ∀ (k : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (v : ℕ) (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), (Std.HashMap.insert M k v)[a]? = a.lookupPos ((k, v) :: m)
∀ (L R : List UInt8), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes (L ++ R) = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes L ++ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes R
∀ (bs : List Bool), ∃ r, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.toBytes bs) = bs ++ List.replicate r Bool.false
∀ (k : ℕ) (bs : List Bool), bs.length ≤ 8 * k → ∃ r, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.toBytesAux k bs) = bs ++ List.replicate r Bool.false
∀ (bs : List UInt8) (i : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.getBit { data := bs.toArray } i = (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes bs).toArray[i]?
∀ (bs : List UInt8) (i : ℕ), (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.fromBytes bs)[i]? = if h : i / 8 < bs.length then Option.some (bs[i / 8].toNat / 2 ^ (i % 8) % 2 == 1) else Option.none
∀ (k n j : ℕ), (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k n)[j]? = if j < k then Option.some (n / 2 ^ j % 2 == 1) else Option.none
∀ {t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable} {i q : ℕ} {v : Option Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, i ≠ q → (Array.setIfInBounds t i v)[q]? = t[q]?
∀ {t : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.CueTable} {i : ℕ} {v : Option Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, i < Array.size t → (Array.setIfInBounds t i v)[i]? = Option.some v

∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (p : ℕ) (n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (m : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.JamTable) (pos : ℕ), a.lookupPos m = Option.some p → a.lookupPos (n.jamAux m pos).2 = Option.some p

∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (p : ℕ) (n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (m : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.JamTable) (pos : ℕ), a.lookupPos (n.jamAux m pos).2 = Option.some p → a.lookupPos m = Option.some p ∨ pos ≤ p ∧ p < pos + (n.jamAux m pos).1.length ∧ a.size ≤ n.size
Minidregg.Theory.Noun → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastTable → ℕ → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW × Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastTable × ℕ

∀ (n : Minidregg.Theory.Noun) (M : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.FastTable) (m : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.JamTable) (pos : ℕ) (w : Minidregg.Theory.Noun.BitW), w.Inv → (∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), M[a]? = a.lookupPos m) → (n.jamFastAux M pos w).1.bits = w.bits ++ (n.jamAux m pos).1 ∧ (n.jamFastAux M pos w).1.Inv ∧ (n.jamFastAux M pos w).2.2 = pos + (n.jamAux m pos).1.length ∧ ∀ (a : Minidregg.Theory.Noun), (n.jamFastAux M pos w).2.1[a]? = a.lookupPos (n.jamAux m pos).2
∀ {a b : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, a.jam = b.jam → a = b
∀ (k n : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBitsLoop k n = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k n
∀ (a b n : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits (a + b) n = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits a n ++ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits b (n / 2 ^ a)
∀ (a n : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits a (n % 2 ^ a) = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits a n
∀ (l : List Bool) (k : ℕ), l.length ≤ k → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits l) = l ++ List.replicate (k - l.length) Bool.false
∀ {k c : ℕ}, c < 2 ^ k → ∀ (b : Bool), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits (k + 1) (c + if b = Bool.true then 2 ^ k else 0) = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k c ++ [b]
∀ (k : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k 0 = List.replicate k Bool.false
∀ {a b : Minidregg.Theory.Noun}, a.mug ≠ b.mug → a ≠ b
∀ (l₁ l₂ : List Bool), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits (l₁ ++ l₂) = Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits l₁ + 2 ^ l₁.length * Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits l₂
∀ (k n : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits k n) = n % 2 ^ k

∀ (B : Array Bool) (L : List Bool) (i acc pw : ℕ), Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i L → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.readBits B L.length i acc pw = Option.some (acc + pw * Minidregg.Theory.Noun.ofBits L)

∀ {B : Array Bool} {i n : ℕ}, Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat n) → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.rub B i = Option.some (n, i + (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.mat n).length)

∀ {B : Array Bool} {i n b c : ℕ}, n < 2 ^ b → 0 < c → 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ b → b < 2 ^ c → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.Matches B i (List.replicate c Bool.false ++ Bool.true :: (Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits (c - 1) b ++ Minidregg.Theory.Noun.natBits b n)) → Minidregg.Theory.Noun.rub B i = Option.some (n, i + (c + c + b))
